# Code Anchors: Epic Approval Gate

- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — takes intent directly, right-sizes, presents the decision-grade digest, and on approval files the epic and its story issues together, committing nothing to the queue at planning; the oversized branch files one backlog stub issue per functional goal instead, and a promotion re-enters by issue number; the right-size phase opens with the sharpness precondition, a third entry mode consumes a finished discovery, and the epic is translated before the digest so the gate reads the filed wording.
- `components/commands/nxs.epic.md` — the razor obligations landed in this stage: the source text materialized before drafting, the necessity answer written into the epic body, the gate's blocking findings stopping the digest, the cut list and third approval action, and the derived filing body every issue is created from.
- `components/agents/nxs-epic-gate.md` — the gate that runs the shared checker against the draft and its source text, reports blocking findings as high, and carries mechanism observations to the digest.
- `components/skills/nxs-gh-create-epic/SKILL.md` — files the epic issue from the epic document, or populates an unplanned epic's own issue in place when promoting one, embedding the raw planning frontmatter for the resolver and resolving the epic's target repo, classification and project through the shared resolver.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/epic-filer/design.ts` — applies the needs-design label from the complexity rollup, upserting before applying.
- `libs/delivery-config/src/story-filer/create.ts` — files one issue per story as children of the epic, resolving the story target repo independently of the epic's.
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — addresses the epic where it was filed, resolving that target once and threading it onto every issue operation.
